description: Ten web search actions covered English and Romanian terms, February weekly windows, public-sector unions, police, pupils/students, rail and miners, with selected city/sector queries. Open-web search is not LexisNexis or a systematic regional archive; many leads remain search-only and no exhaustive absence claim is supported.
required_followup: Use additional contemporary regional, local, official and rights-organization records where available; retain language/archive coverage limits.

description: The mixed public-sector Cotroceni/Government gathering is described as “zeci”; the police-specific count and relation between locations are unresolved. Photo captions were read, but linked photos were not inspected.
required_followup: Seek independent contemporaneous reporting or organizer/official record establishing count and whether the groups/locations were one event.

description: The pupils/student protest is described as “zeci,” which does not establish 50; organization is also unresolved.
required_followup: Find independent contemporaneous attendance reporting and evidence naming the organizer.

description: TVR reports a few hundred miners outside in solidarity, separately from miners remaining underground, but does not securely establish the outside gathering start date/site or link government negotiations to those outside attendees. The wage arrears were owed by CEH; whether the public demand targeted national government is unresolved.
required_followup: Identify a contemporaneous report that dates and locates the public gathering and distinguishes it from the underground stoppage; verify the state-target and episode-specific response.

description: AGERPRES announces a planned railway-worker protest for 24 February, 11:00–13:00. This article provides no confirmation that the planned gathering occurred; 23 February is the publication date, not an observed event date.
required_followup: Seek post-event evidence of execution/attendance before coding a physical protest; do not infer occurrence, turnout, duration or outcome from the announcement.

description: For the Giurgiu and 16 February police events, reports give roughly two-hour durations without precise physical start/end clocks. For the other candidates, no physical end is established. Future plans in S028 are not treated as continuations.
required_followup: Look for contemporaneous reports of physical closure; keep end dates null until established.

description: The reviewed accounts do not establish all seven event-specific state responses or protester violence. S021 contains union allegations and an official denial, not verified coercive outcomes. S022 describes formal negotiation/guarantees in the broader underground wage-stoppage context; accommodation is not attributed to the outside crowd.
required_followup: Keep unknowns; seek event-specific independent corroboration without converting allegations, silence or an unrelated government statement into coded outcomes.

description: Each of the six body-read cards has one report; S022 explicitly credits AGERPRES and is not independent confirmation. The other 42 relevant search-header cards remain search-only. A different AGERPRES URL and a different TVR URL had prior exact-URL 403s; neither is transferred to these opened exact URLs.
required_followup: Seek independent accounts and keep each source-specific restriction at its exact URL/publisher scope.
